name: StockAI - approved purchase order to Slack and Google Sheets

parameters.text: =Purchase order {{ $json.data.po_number }} was approved for {{ $json.data.approved_amount }} ({{ $json.data.sku_count }} SKUs, {{ $json.data.total_units }} units). Approved by {{ $json.data.decided_by }}.

parameters.content:
StockAI event: purchase_order.approved.

1. In StockAI (Automation > Webhooks) create a webhook pointing at this workflow's production URL and subscribe it to purchase_order.approved only.
2. Put its signing secret in the n8n variable STOCKAI_WEBHOOK_SECRET and allow the crypto module (NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto).
3. Pick the Slack channel and the Sheet, and select your credentials.

Not yet imported into a live n8n by the authors: check each node after importing.
